title: Replace embedded rust-ipfs with Kubo HTTP client + FS cache
description: The embedded rust-ipfs node uses in-memory storage — articles are lost on restart and the block store cannot be inspected by standard IPFS tooling. Replace with a KuboClient (reqwest over Kubo HTTP RPC API) wrapped in an FsCacheStore (local FS write-through cache). Both transit and reader get the same implementation from core. api_url and cache_path become real config fields. IpnsPublisher migrates to /api/v0/name/publish.
